zoe_sales: FYI  new prospect (payments gateway) wants a 72h POC: BYOK with HSM-backed CMKs, daily ephemeral KEKs, and an auditable offline key ceremony. They also want cost transparency up front. Can we scope?

omar_se: Short answer: doable. Two POC topologies: Hosted + external HSM proxy (fast) or Dedicated in their VPC + customer HSM cluster (best perf). Hosted proxy adds per-op latency.

hani_crypto: Crypto notes: We can generate DEKs, wrap with customer CMK via PKCS#11/CloudHSM. For daily ephemeral KEKs we recommend a wrapped-DEK rotation (create new DEK, wrap, start issuing). They want attestations for every wrap: we can emit signed receipts and forward to their SIEM.

zoe_sales: Can you give a rough pricing example I can show them? They want numbers to budget.

omar_se: Ballpark (example only): Hosted base $0.02/token mo + HSM-proxy addon $150/mo + $0.50 per 1k crypto ops. Dedicated: connector $2,000/mo + $250 per million wrap ops. Onboarding/ceremony one-time: $8k. These are placeholders until we get qps.

hani_crypto: Perf numbers: external HSM proxy typically adds ~10-30ms per wrap, vendor + network dependent. If they expect >1k wrap/s inline, recommend Dedicated or prefix-caching of wrapped DEKs.

rick_ops: Ops checklist for POC: we need their HSM endpoint IPs, mTLS cert, expected concurrency, and preferred maintenance window. We'll stand up a staging pool, enable wrap latency dashboards, and run a 72h soak.

zoe_sales: They asked whether daily rotation impacts SLA and downtime.

hani_crypto: No downtime if we use atomic rotate: create new DEK, wrap, flip tokens to new DEK, retire old after TTL. We'll include rollback steps if wrap fails; document in runbook.

marta_legal: For the SOW: Key Custody Addendum required stating Redwood never has plaintext CMK access. If they want third-party escrow and dual-custody, add chain-of-custody terms and a retrieval fee. I'll draft language.

omar_se: Quick sample firewall snippet they can paste:
```
# customer firewall -> redwood proxy
allow tcp 198.51.100.44:443 -> 203.0.113.10:8443 (mTLS client-auth)
# client cert: /etc/keys/customer-mtls.pem
```
Also sample smoke test:
```
$ pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/yourhsm.so -l --list-objects
$ curl -X POST https://poc.redwood.example/wrap -d '{"key":"test"}' --cert client.pem
```

rick_ops: I'll create the POC ticket and schedule staging infra. Need 48h heads-up before dry-run.

ticket-bot: ticket created  sales/poc-1865432100-byo-hsm: assignee=omar_se; due=3 days.

zoe_sales: Great. I'll send these numbers as placeholders and confirm concurrent qps + a Thurs meeting at 9am PT. Thanks all :raised_hands:
